title: My mum's job
instructions: Emre annesinin işini anlatıyor. İş yerine ve çalışma saatlerine dikkat et.

script.speaker: emre
script.text: My mum is a teacher. She teaches music.

script.speaker: emre
script.text: She works at a big school in the city centre.

script.speaker: emre
script.text: She goes to work by bus at half past seven.

script.speaker: emre
script.text: She comes home at four o'clock.

script.speaker: emre
script.text: She loves her job, but she is always tired in the evening.
